data.text:
A. Mohiddeen vs Food Safety Officer Manjeswar Circle on 25 
June, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.8397/2023 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Tuesday, the 25th day of June 2024 / 4th Ashadha, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2023 In Crl.Mc No. 8397 Of 2023
 Cc 1410/2022 Of Court Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class -Ii, Kasaragod
 Petitioners/Petitioners/Accused Nos 1 To 6:
 1. A. Mohiddeen, Aged 51 Years, S/O Abdul Rahiman, Darul Munazza,
 Hosbettu Opp Government Hospital, Manjeshwar Kasargod, Pin -
 671323. And 5 Others. 
 Respondents/Complainant, State & Another:
 1. Food Safety Officer Manjeswar Circle Civil Station Kasargod, Pin -
 671123. And 2 Others. 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the  High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in C.C.1410/2022 on  the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrates Court II, Kasargod,
 pending disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders and upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 27/03/2024 in CRL.MA.1/2023 and  upon hearing the arguments of MR.PREMJIT NAGENDRAN, Advocate for the  petitioners, the Public Prosecutor for the Ist and 2nd respondents and  Smt. Chitra P. George, Standing Counsel for 3rd respondent, the court  passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order shall stand extended by six months.
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 25-06-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar A. Mohiddeen vs Food Safety Officer Manjeswar Circle on 25 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51973923/
